subject: Renewal: Proposal for premium support and latency SLO upgrade
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@activio.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Activio Procurement <procurement@activio.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: support & SLO questions

Karthik,

Our renewal window is coming up and the product team has a few asks that may change the terms for next year. High-level: we want to upgrade to a premium support tier and tighten latency SLOs for our chat endpoints. Specifically:

- Target: p95 latency <= 150ms for the chat/generate route (our peak is sensitive)
- 24/7 named TAM and 15-minute incident response SLA for Sev1
- Increase committed capacity to cover a 2x peak GPU baseline for Q3/Q4 usage
- Options for 12 vs 24 month term with pricing/discounts

I've attached a short PDF with our requested changes (Activio_SLA_Change_Request.pdf). Can you share pricing and whether Redwood can guarantee credits for SLO misses? Also we'd like a short canary/capacity validation plan before we flip production traffic.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Director, Platform Engineering
Activio

--
Attachment: Activio_SLA_Change_Request.pdf (1 page summary)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@activio.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Jun 2028 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: support & SLO questions

Olivia —

Appreciate the clear ask and the PDF. We can absolutely support a premium SLA and help validate the latency target, though a few details affect cost and rollout. Draft options below — happy to walk through in a 30-minute call next week.

Option A — Premium Support Add-on (minimal changes to commit)
- 24/7 named TAM + 15-min Sev1 response
- Priority incident bridge, quarterly architecture reviews
- SLO: 99.9% availability; latency targets monitored but no service credits
- Price: +20% on current renewal rate (pro-rated)

Option B — Premium SLA + Latency SLO (recommended for production-critical workloads)
- All Option A items + formal latency SLO: p95 <= 150ms for chat/generate under defined traffic profile
- Service credits: 5% of monthly invoice per missed SLA interval (capped at 50%)
- Dedicated 2x baseline GPU capacity reservation during business hours (optional add-on)
- Price: +35% base; 24-month commit qualifies for 15% discount off the uplift

Option C — Dedicated Deployment + Performance Guarantee
- Private/dedicated pool with pinned capacity, custom kernel tuning and quantization profile
- Onboarded performance runbook, full telemetry access (read-only dashboards)
- SLA: 99.95% availability, latency SLO p95 <= 150ms guaranteed
- Price: custom (we'll need procurement numbers), recommended for customers who cannot accept variability

Operational notes:
- Canary plan: staged traffic ramp over 2 weeks with telemetry gates (we'll share the template).
- Rollback policy: automatic fallback to a compatible model variant + regional routing for traffic spikes.
- Telemetry: we'll provide a dedicated dashboard and log retention for audit for the term.

I've attached our premium support terms (Redwood_Premium_Support_Terms_2028.pdf) showing sample credits and definitions. Stephanie — can you confirm TAM availability and estimated onboarding lead time?

Next steps:
1) Quick 30-min sync with Olivia + Rajiv to align on Option B vs C and traffic profile
2) Draft SLA amendment and show DocuSign-ready language
3) Agree on pricing/term (12 vs 24 months) and any trial period for the latency SLO

Available slots: Tue 6/6 10–11am PT, Wed 6/7 3–4pm PT.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: Redwood_Premium_Support_Terms_2028.pdf (6 pages)

From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@activio.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@activio.com>, procurement@activio.com
Date: Thu, 08 Jun 2028 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: support & SLO questions

Karthik —

Thanks for the concrete options. A few follow-ups from the engineering team: 

- We need a firm definition of the traffic profile used for the 150ms p95 target (concurrency, average seq length, region). Please include the benchmark harness or sample data used.
- Service credits need to be predictable and tied to measurement windows. Can you propose a specific credit calculation and measurement window?
- Canary plan: can you share the telemetry gates and sample dashboard widgets we would see? Live metrics are important for our SREs.

We're leaning to Option B with a 24-month commit if the numbers are reasonable and we can get a 10–12% price concession or a 3-month premium support credit to offset onboarding. Also requesting a named TAM during the validation window.

If you can draft the amendment language and a canary checklist, we can fast-track the procurement review.

Thanks,
Rajiv Patel
Principal SRE
Activio

On Thu, Jun 8, 2028 at 09:00 AM -0700, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@activio.com> wrote:
> Karthik —
> >Quick note: Rajiv will lead the SRE review. He may ping for low-level kernel/quantization details.
> >Olivia

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: support & SLO questions — negotiation stance

Team —

Thanks for the thread and to Rajiv/Olivia for the clarity. Suggested negotiation posture and offer we can present to Activio: 

- Offer: Option B (Premium SLA + Latency SLO at p95 <= 150ms) with the following concessions:
  - 24-month committed term
  - 12% commercial concession on the premium uplift, OR 3 months complimentary premium support (we should present both and let them choose)
  - Service credit definition: percentage of monthly invoice per measurement window where p95 > 150ms, measured on a daily sliding window; cap at 50% monthly credit. Stephanie, please use the standard credit table in the attached draft.

- Operational commitments:
  - Assign Stephanie as named TAM — she will own onboarding and quarterly reviews
  - Provide read-only telemetry dashboard and a canary validation runbook (2-week ramp, pre-defined gates)
  - Offer a one-time performance tuning workshop with the Research/Applied ML team prior to full cutover

- Commercials: lock price for 24 months with yearly CPI clause; ensure we include an option to add burst capacity at defined rates.

Karthik — please book the sync with Activio for Mon/Tue next week. Stephanie — can you draft the DocuSign amendment and populate the SLA_amendment_draft.pdf with the credit table + TAM assignment? I'll approve the 12% concession for this deal.

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

--
Attachment: SLA_amendment_draft.pdf (4 pages: credit table, TAM assignment, canary runbook template)
